title: Define tool output reference, citation extraction, and route-independent refs boundaries
description: AstrBot dashboard chat, live_chat, and OpenAPI routes duplicate logic for collecting web_search tool results, matching <ref> tags, adding favicons, and saving refs in bot history. Rust should place tool-result reference extraction in a tool/agent boundary so WebChat, realtime, OpenAPI, and future dashboard history routes do not parse provider/tool output ad hoc.

files.change: Model supported reference-producing tools, parsed result items, ref tags, and citation payloads independent of web routes.
Attach extracted refs to agent/chat response metadata without mixing with streaming transport.
Persist route-independent refs alongside bot history without forcing storage to understand tool-call internals.
Keep HTTP/SSE/WebSocket routes limited to serializing reference DTOs produced by agent/tool services.

criteria: WebChat, realtime chat, and OpenAPI routes do not duplicate web_search ref extraction.
Tool reference extraction consumes typed tool-call results rather than arbitrary route-local JSON maps.
Conversation history can store refs without coupling to specific web transport code.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-tool && cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
